info.title: Online Market HTTP API
info.description: HTTP/JSON API for the Online Market storefront and administration clients.

tags.name: AdminOrderService
tags.description: Authenticated order administration and audit history.

tags.name: OrderService
tags.description: Public checkout and capability-token order lookup.

delete.summary: Products referenced by carts or orders are preserved and marked archived.

unitPrice.description: If omitted, the current catalog price is used.

expectedVersion.description: Zero disables the optimistic concurrency check.

currencyCode.description: Currency expected by the client. Initially only RUB is supported.

cartToken.description:
The client must keep this token private and send it in subsequent cart
requests. It is returned only when a cart is created.

idempotencyKey.description:
A unique key generated by a client for one checkout attempt. Repeating a
request with this key must not create another order.

orderToken.description: Required for public order lookup. It is returned only after checkout.

v1Money.description:
Money stores an amount in the smallest currency unit. For example,
19990 with currency_code "RUB" means 199.90 RUB.

v1OrderItem.description:
OrderItem is a snapshot. Its name and price do not change when the catalog
product is edited later.

v1PageRequest.description:
PageRequest describes cursor-based pagination. A page token is opaque to a
client and must be passed back unchanged.
